blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: LMC — Little Man Computer, simplified stored-program model.

blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: LMC is a teaching model of a stored-program accumulator processor: mailboxes hold instructions or data, and ACC holds the immediate working value.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: INP replaces ACC; STA copies ACC into a mailbox; LDA copies a mailbox's contents into ACC; ADD adds mailbox contents to ACC.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: OUT writes current ACC to output. Trace ACC separately from mailbox contents and PC instruction addresses.

blocks.title: Worked example · Follow the reasoning
blocks.text: FIRST6, second INP sets ACC3, ADD FIRST gives9, OUT9.
